blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Quezon City has abolished its Task Force Disiplina effective Tuesday and ordered its members to undergo strict background checks, neuropsychological examinations, and drug testing before they can return to the Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS). “Wala nang awtorisadong operasyon o pagroronda sa ilalim ng Task Force Disiplina,” said the city government in a statement on Tuesday, with instructions from Mayor Joy Belmonte ordering all its members to immediately return to and report to their mother unit, the DPOS.
